from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List

class FinancialReport(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial data from a single document."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company")
    report_period_end: str = Field(description="End date of the reporting period in YYYY-MM-DD format")
    undistributed_profit: float = Field(description="Undistributed Profit value at period end")
    currency: str = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g., 'Yuan' or 'CNY'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    reports: List[FinancialReport]
